verbose.description: Enable verbose output (repeat with -v/-vv for more verbosity).

homedir.description: GnuPG home directory (overrides GNUPGHOME and registry).

keyserver.description: LDAP server for certificate lookup (deprecated; use dirmngr configuration instead).

no_autostart.description: Prevent automatic start of gpg-agent or dirmngr.

log_file.description: Log file path (use 'socket://' to log to a socket).

policy_checks.description: Enable or disable policy checks (enabled by default).

crl_checks.description: Enable or disable CRL checks via Dirmngr (enabled by default).

trusted_cert_crl_check.description: Enable or disable CRL checks for trusted root certificates.

force_crl_refresh.description: Force dirmngr to reload CRL on each request (should not be used in config file).

issuer_based_crl_check.description: Enable CRL check even for certificates without a CRL distribution point.

ocsp.description: Enable OCSP checks via Dirmngr (disabled by default).

auto_issuer_key_retrieve.description: Enable automatic retrieval of missing issuer certificates (set to false to disable).

validation_model.description: Validation model: shell (default), chain, or steed.

ignore_cert_extension.description: List of certificate extension OIDs to ignore (treat as non-critical).

base64.description: Use base64 encoding without PEM headers.

p12_charset.description: Charset for PKCS#12 passphrase encoding (e.g., Latin1, CP850).

default_key.description: Default key (by fingerprint, email, etc.) for signing.

local_user.description: Key(s) to use for signing (overrides default-key; repeatable).

with_validation.description: Perform full validation on key listing operations.

with_md5_fingerprint.description: Include MD5 fingerprint in key listings.

with_secret.description: Include secret key presence info in listings.

no_pretty_dn.description: Output distinguished names in RFC-2253 format.

include_certs.description: Number of certificates to include in CMS: -2 (skip root), -1 (all), 0 (none), 1 (signer only), n>1 (up to n).

cipher_algo.description: Cipher OID or alias (3DES, AES, AES256) for encryption.

digest_algo.description: Message digest algorithm (e.g., SHA256). Use with caution for interoperability.

always_trust.description: Skip certificate chain validation during encryption.

ignore_cert_with_oid.description: List of extended key usage OIDs to ignore during smartcard learning.

no_common_certs_import.description: Suppress import of common certificates during keybox creation.

debug_level.description: Debug level: none, basic, advanced, expert, or guru.

pinentry_mode.description: Pinentry behavior: default, ask, cancel, error, loopback.

request_origin.description: Operation origin: local (default), remote, or browser.

assert_signer.description: Fingerprint (compact, no colons) or path to file listing fingerprints to require for signatures.

min_rsa_length.description: Minimum RSA key length (bits) for de-vs compliance.

require_compliance.description: Force exit failure if compliance rules are violated.
